_meta: One batch of tokens routed through a Mixture-of-Experts layer. Each token has a gate vector -- the router's probability over the num_experts experts (each row sums to 1). Top-1 routing sends each token to its highest-gate expert. gates are chosen so the router prefers expert 0: five of the eight tokens route there, one expert gets none. That imbalance is the MoE failure mode -- 'routing collapse' -- where a few experts do all the work and others are never trained (dead experts), wasting the model's capacity. The load-balancing auxiliary loss E * sum_e (fraction_to_e * mean_gate_e) measures it: it equals 1.0 when load is uniform and rises as it concentrates. capacity_factor sets each expert's capacity = capacity_factor * tokens / num_experts; tokens beyond an expert's capacity overflow and are dropped. Every load, loss, and drop here is computed.
